result.summary: Corrected godot/test/construction_columns_focus.gd's constant-expression defect: replaced `const FOCUS_SUITES: PackedStringArray = PackedStringArray([...])` (not a valid constant expression in the installed Godot) with `const FOCUS_SUITES: Array[String] = [...]`, and `_discover_suites()` now returns `PackedStringArray(FOCUS_SUITES)` built at runtime. Suite contents and order (test_construction.gd, test_construction_columns.gd, test_save_owner_construction.gd) and the run_tests.gd inheritance/override structure are unchanged. No other file touched, no production change, no claim of execution.

extends "res://test/run_tests.gd"
## Focused runner for the CONSTRUCTION-S4-VALIDATE-R01v2 tranche.
##
## Reuses run_tests.gd's whole supervisor/worker/marker-audit machinery unchanged, overriding
## only suite discovery so exactly the two new suites plus the existing test_construction.gd run,
## not the whole test directory. Usage, from the repository root:
##     godot --headless --path godot --script test/construction_columns_focus.gd

const FOCUS_SUITES: Array[String] = [
	"res://test/test_construction.gd",
	"res://test/test_construction_columns.gd",
	"res://test/test_save_owner_construction.gd",
]


func _discover_suites() -> PackedStringArray:
	"""Exactly the three suites this focused tranche must run, in this fixed order."""
	return PackedStringArray(FOCUS_SUITES)
